methodology.catalogue: All 451 entries processed programmatically; both branch catalogues are identical.
methodology.unit: One exercise_id per exercise; each distinct PNG SHA256 is a separate saved version. Identical blobs in both branches are one version with two locations.
methodology.current_review: Explicit user_review bound to the current/accepted hash. work for shared runs; agent-02 own manifest for its ten exercises. Earlier review requests normalize to rejected only for their versions.
methodology.pending: Only an existing submitted current PNG marked pending counts as awaiting review. Default pending on never-generated/failed no-PNG records remains raw evidence; effective review is unknown.
methodology.equipment: Instruction-first; specific Smith/cable descriptions and reviewed exceptions. Specialized includes dedicated strength apparatus, supported hyperextension/GHD stations and stationary cardio/ergometers. Cable means an explicitly prescribed attachment/pulley station, not every machine with an internal cable. Static bars/parallel bars, ropes, wrist rollers, bands and free weights are other. Ambiguous means unresolved placement among these equipment groups; pose/muscle issues are separate.
methodology.machine_category: machine is a catalogue label, never by itself an exact construction. No brand, lever design, plate/stack mechanism, or missing attachment is invented.
methodology.verification: Read committed Git blobs, compare SHA256 to current progress/manifests, inspect PNG signature and IHDR dimensions. No image was displayed, rendered, generated, edited, visually evaluated or obtained from external image/reference services. No new pixel/transparency/decode QA; previous technical results retained as recorded evidence.
methodology.scope_limit: Only fetched committed snapshots of the two selected remote branches. Unpushed files/outputs and attachments in other cloud tasks may be unavailable; this audit cannot establish their absence there. Historical absolute paths are metadata, not evidence of current filesystem availability.
